about.title: Who We Are
about.lead: R&E Petroleum co., based in the State of Kuwait, is a major material supplier and contracting company for a wide range of materials and services related to the Oil & Gas industries, Power Stations and the Commercial sector.
about.text: Our commitment to quality, on-time service delivery with best value and satisfactory after-sale services introduced us to several important projects in the Gulf Area and Middle East, and has established strong business relations with giant companies.
